Why Do Rainbows Appear After Rain? The Sun's Magic Mirror! — The storm clears, sunlight streams through wet trees, and BAM—a giant seven-color arch paints the sky! How does it work?
Kids science answer for "why do rainbows appear kids science cartoon" with fun 2D animation by BabyBeats Rhymo!

Sunlight looks white, but it's made of 7 colors; raindrops act as tiny glass prisms that bend and reflect colors at different angles into a glorious rainbow.

BabyBeats Rhymo creates kid-safe 2D science cartoons and funny educational stories every day for curious US kids and families!
